slides.title: Occupiers are back; capital is still cautious
slides.notes: Demand is improving faster than investment. Vacancy is at 8.0% and take-up is 11% above average, but investment is 36% below its long-term average.

slides.title: Vacancy fell to 8.0%, the lowest since Q1 2024
slides.so_what: Less space on the market supports rents in the core submarkets.
slides.notes: Vacancy has fallen from 9.9% in Q1 2024 to 8.0%. Take-up of 3.10m sq ft is 11% above the long-term average.

slides.title: Investment £2.00bn: one Docklands deal masks a thin City
slides.so_what: City pricing evidence is scarce; lean on the Churchill Place yield for valuations.
slides.notes: The Barclays purchase of 1 Churchill Place lifted Docklands & Stratford to £0.75bn. City & Southbank was £0.37bn against a £1.60bn average.
